Package View

package View
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    BackButton
    A reusable navigation button that returns the user to the main menu.
    GameGrid
    A Swing panel displaying the interactive grid of GridCell buttons.
    GamePlayPanel
    The primary gameplay screen displaying player scores, navigation controls, the game grid, and a victory overlay upon game completion.
    GameSizeButton
    A button that starts a new game with a specific board size and the entered player names.
    GameStartPanel
    Setup screen where players enter their names and choose a board size before starting a match.
    GridCell
    A visual button representing a single cell in GameGrid.
    MainView
    Manages the primary application JFrame and handles switching between UI panels.
    MenuPanel
    The main menu panel displaying options to start a game or exit the application.
